title: Correlate Codex sends with clientUserMessageId
description:
Codex has the same ambiguity as Claude Code. A `turn/steer` response means only that input was queued, nothing dedupes a retry, and an interrupt discards pending input. A timeout leaves the outcome unknown.

Change:
- Send `clientUserMessageId` on `turn/start` and `turn/steer`.
- Treat the RPC response as queued, and settle as started on the matching userMessage item.
- Treat an RPC timeout as unconfirmed, using the same browser states as the Claude Code work.

Also check whether Codex rollouts record `clientUserMessageId`. The 20 most recent rollouts on the test machine do not, but devhost does not send it yet, so that sample proves nothing.
